metadata.title: Barnängshuset – A World Away From The Noise
metadata.description: Creative office building in Södermalm, Stockholm. Calm workspace with nature proximity and curated access to the best local culture.

sections.headline:
A world away
from the noise.
sections.intro: Eight minutes from everything. Calm focus, proximity to nature, and curated access to the best cafés, bars, and shops in Södermalm.

image.alt: Barnängshuset exterior — industrial brick building in Södermalm

sections.headline: A building with a century of stories. Space for the next chapter.
sections.body: Originally a textile mill on the edge of Södermalm, Barnängshuset has been reimagined as a workspace where history and modernity coexist—without compromising either.

sections.headline: The Story of Barnängshuset
sections.body: The building's industrial architecture—massive timber beams, dramatic windows, soaring ceilings—creates the perfect backdrop for focused work and inspired collaboration. We've preserved what made this place special: the sense of scale, the craftsmanship, the character. Then we added what makes it work today: modern amenities, flexible spaces, and a community of thinkers and makers.
sections.pullQuote: Distance from the center creates better boundaries. Proximity to nature improves how we think.

sections.headline: Everything Built In
sections.intro: A place designed to support how you actually work.

amenities.name: Studio Gym
amenities.description: Fully equipped gym with weights, cardio, and daily classes. Shower and changing rooms included.

amenities.name: Quiet Lounge
amenities.description: Soft seating, natural light, and no distractions. For focused reading or thinking.

amenities.name: Eatery
amenities.description: In-house restaurant. Weekday lunches, coffee bar, and a menu that changes with the seasons.

amenities.name: Conference Rooms
amenities.description: Flexible meeting spaces from boardrooms to presentation halls. AV-equipped throughout.

sections.headline: Eight Minutes From Everything
sections.intro: Vitabergsparken for afternoon walks. SoFo for coffee and culture. Everything within reach.

spots.name: Vitabergsparken
spots.description: Stockholm's most beloved park. Open meadows, forest trails, and a view over the city from the top.

spots.name: Café SoFo
spots.description: Best morning coffee in the neighborhood. Homemade pastries and a calm corner seat.

spots.name: Bistro Nora
spots.description: French-inspired bistro. Perfect for team lunches or Friday aperitivos.

spots.name: Vintage & Ink
spots.description: Curated vintage furniture and design objects. A treasure hunt for the office.

spots.name: Kultur Bar
spots.description: Live music every Thursday. Craft cocktails and a scene. Where Södermalm comes to gather.

spots.name: Søgaard Gallery
spots.description: Rotating exhibitions. Emerging Nordic artists. A reason to step away from the desk.

sections.headline: Let's Talk
sections.intro: Whether you're looking for office space, want to book a conference room, or just curious—we'd love to hear from you.
